sayLines.text: 💛 You hold Boot stone. You carry a guilt like a stone in the boot. So you carry a stone in the boot — the scattering took the one person you were keeping alive, and this is the shape of that. It keeps you honest. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted,
